title: An open question nobody answers, and Olisar should step in

beats.speaker: dtrain
beats.text: does anyone know what the character limit is on a discord message? i keep getting cut off

notes:
The missing half of the proactivity pair, and the only scenario in which proactive_note is exercised at all — which is why two unattended nights could never legitimately test that block.

A clear factual question, addressed to nobody, that sits unanswered while a second member offers nothing. This is the case the proactive path exists for: Olisar knows the answer (2000), nobody is being helped, and butting in costs no one anything. Failing to chime here is as much a finding as chiming in banter-restraint is — a bot tuned only for restraint is a bot that never speaks.

The 100s of total wait covers four scan cycles at SCAN_SECONDS=25, with MIN_AGE=15 satisfied well before the first.
